parsed.why: Worst-tier anti-trans legislation; state law permits bathroom exclusion in many state-run facilities and lacks state GI hate-crime or discrimination protection. National border/document exposure remains. Lowest.

Low-risk tier; explicit gender-identity discrimination ban with enforceable commission remedies, open ID rules and city sanctuary. No adult bathroom ban. Lacks GI hate-crime recourse but clearly above parent.

Low-risk legal ranking but national legislature imposes a facility restriction locally, with protest arrests; local law can be overridden by national action. National border exposure remains. Below parent.

Patchwork: no adult bathroom ban and some employment/conversion-therapy protections, but school-only facility ban, GI excluded from hate-crime law, and protections limited to 19 municipalities. Near parent.

Most Protective tier: statewide public-accommodations and discrimination bans, GI hate-crime coverage, care shield and self-declared ID. Only unrepealed unenforced sodomy provisions detract. Highest, but national border exposure caps.
